penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Any solution here is a software feature that must be built into FOSSBilling or delivered as a custom plugin/integration — there is no repeatable, automated service the factory can deliver per-customer without manual dev work.

rationale: The pain is real (single all-or-nothing API keys are a genuine security pattern problem for billing operators) but this is fundamentally a feature request for an open-source platform, not a monetizable standalone service. The buyers — small hosting providers running FOSSBilling — are deeply cost-sensitive and accustomed to free/open-source tooling; there is no evidence they pay for API security add-ons. Building and delivering a scoped-API-key solution would require custom plugin development per platform and cannot be automated by Claude + standard tooling, making it incompatible with the factory's autonomous delivery model.
solution_plan: Not viable as a factory service. If this pain recurs across WHMCS, Blesta, and other billing platforms with paying user bases, the pattern might justify a hosted multi-platform billing security audit tool — but that would need fresh discovery and validated willingness to pay before the factory should act on it.
notes: Dropped. build_gate failures: buildability_with_ai (2, floor 6), operational_autonomy (2, floor 7), buyer_clarity (5, floor 6), willingness_to_pay (3, floor 5). This is a platform feature request, not a deliverable micro-service.
